caption: The drawing depicts two abstract, geometric human figures sitting opposite each other on chairs. The figure on the left is dressed in a light purple outfit, has dark hair, and is seated on a brown chair. The figure on the right is dressed in a plaid-patterned blue and beige outfit with a large, pointed green and yellow hat or scarf, and sits on a red chair. The right figure is holding a blue, conical object that appears to be an umbrella. Both figures face each other and are in close proximity, with the left figure holding what looks like a piece of paper or envelope extended toward the other. The background is a textured, brownish-olive color with some lighter and darker areas, bordered by a slightly lighter frame. The forms are composed of flat, angular shapes, with dark outlines defining facial features and limbs.
title: Patchwork Picture: "Gossips"
